spec: §10: "INT(width, bytes) to iN with width = N (else E_ARG), F64 to f64, QREG to qreg[n] with the register's n, TOKEN to token"
derivation: Construct args with all four setters. Width-8 INT bytes 34 maps to 52, F64 0.5 stays 0.5, qreg[2] bits [1,0] maps wire 0=1, TOKEN preserves its four limits. Replacing any kind or INT width rejects with E_ARG.
